_doc: Boss batch B1 themed pass (TEMPLATE.md sections 9 and 10): coconut-crab-titan, robber-crab-baron, reef-leviathan, ancient-snapper. New motifs live in motifs/boss_boss-B1-coast-water-crabs-reef.js (12 motifs, 3 with their own chain effect). All 4 signature motifs are new and used by no other creature (titan-stride, baron-sash, leviathan-coil, moss-beak). Reused catalogue motifs only where the picture is truly the same: coconut-crack, husk-fibre, surf-foam, crab-clamp (medium m05), rip-pull, coral-castle (large L11), keel-shell, worm-lure, tail-sweep (large L09: the alligator snapper is this boss's smaller cousin), ink-cloud (themes.json). Every piece, unique and class, has a hand note.

coconut-crab-titan.notes: Coconut crab titan of the islands: a colossal orange-red coconut crab with purple-dark joints, so big you mostly see its spiky legs stepping over you; it climbs palms, drops and cracks coconuts and wears husk on its armour.

u0.n: Husk Crack: a colossal leg tip stabs its way along the edge like a pick, husk fibres tearing loose behind it

u1.n: Coconut Drop: heavy coconuts plummet in from the titan's palm, land with a bonk and split white

u2.n: Titan Shell: the vast ridged back plate locks along the edge and braces, a white sheen sliding over the knobs

u3.n: Husk Rain: shredded coir husk rains down off the edge in quick tan tufts

b0.n: Coconut Crack: hairy coconuts are slammed out and crack open in the titan's grip, white flesh showing

b1.n: Surf Spout: surf breaks on the edge and a water spout jets up where the titan stamps

b2.n: Husk Armour: husk-padded armour plates line the edge, loose fibres drifting off

b3.n: Sand Yank: giant leg tips hook into the sand at spots tied by drag lines and yank, sand spraying

x0.n: Coconut Bait: a tempting coconut turns up at spot after spot, a glint on the husk, then it is gone

x1.n: Titan Pinch: the huge orange-red claw lunges off the edge and snaps shut with a white pip

robber-crab-baron.notes: Robber crab baron of coast and island: a blue-grey robber crab who calls himself a baron, wearing a stolen red sash and a gold ring; pompous and staggering, his armour and shell are patched with loot.

u0.n: Baron Crush: the sashed baron rears up and slams down claws first, dust bursting, the sash flapping

u1.n: Loot Snatch: gold rings are flicked off the edge one after another as the claw snatches and darts away

u2.n: Stolen Armour: a dented pot lid, a stuck-through fork and a red bottle cap bristle out of the stolen armour

u3.n: Shiny Heist: ruby rings scatter out and slip back, gone with a glint before anyone can grab them

b0.n: Robber Shiny Snatch: the baron sidles the length of the edge, ringed claw first, plucking as he goes

b1.n: Sash Spatter: the red silk sash whips off the edge in S-curves, the gold fringe flicking

b2.n: Looted Shell: pot lids and plunder line the edge as a shell, a glint on the loot

b3.n: Bounty Dredge: rings are dredged up out of the sand at spots, tied by drag lines

x0.n: Royal Decree: scrolls unroll at spot after spot and the red wax seal stamps down

x1.n: Finger Clamp: one big blue-grey claw clamps out and back, a white snap pip

reef-leviathan.notes: Reef leviathan of the coast: a vast mottled green sea serpent with a yellow fin crest and yellow eyes; its humps breach out of the reef water, it lurks in coral, whips up whirlpools and swallows prey whole.

u0.n: Tidal Slam: the great humps heave up out of the water and crash down, spray bursting

u1.n: Deep Dive: the humps roll away under the surface and come back up, bubbles streaming

u2.n: Whirlpool: whirlpools spin up off the edge, foam on the rim

u3.n: Swallow Whole: the serpent head runs the length of the edge, lower jaw unhinged, swallowing a fish whole

b0.n: Eel Snap: serpent heads lunge off the edge, jaws gaping on needle teeth, and gulp

b1.n: Breaker Thrash: breakers curl over and thrash down on the edge

b2.n: Eel Slime Coat: the humps lie along the edge under a glossy slime trail

b3.n: Riptide Drag: rip currents spin at spots tied together, dragging

x0.n: Coral Lurk: pink coral heads appear at spot after spot, the leviathan's green head peeking out of the hole

x1.n: Coiling Crush: the humps rise and press out along the edge and hold, squeezing

ancient-snapper.notes: Ancient snapping turtle of the wetland: an alligator snapper centuries old, olive and rough, barnacles and moss on its head and keeled shell; it lies patient on the bottom with its pink worm lure, then the hooked beak slams shut.

u0.n: Snapping Jaw: the mossy beak runs the edge, gaping on its pink lure, then slams shut with a crack

u1.n: Mossy Shell: the three-keeled shell settles along the edge, long weed waving up off the keels

u2.n: Mud Sink: the keeled shell sinks into the murk and slips out and back, mud bubbles rising

u3.n: Ancient Patience: shell scutes rise, a new growth ring added for every year waited

b0.n: Ancient Jaw: the barnacled head lunges off the edge and the hooked beak snaps

b1.n: Mossy Tail Swing: the heavy crested tail sweeps out from side to side, spray off the tip

b2.n: Ageless Shell: ringed scutes line the edge and hold, each ring a century

b3.n: Murk Spray: murky mud clouds bloom and sink off the edge

x0.n: Wriggle Lure: hooked jaws gape at spot after spot, the pink worm tongue wriggling inside

x1.n: Shell Grind: the heavy keeled shell grinds out and back, grit flying
